title: Confidence
description: Confidence is never a single scalar disguised as truth. Attribution, source and freshness are recorded separately and rolled up deterministically with stated reasons.

attribution.description: How certain it is that the subject belongs to this organization.

source.description: How reliable the collecting adapter is for this observation type.

freshness.description: How recent the underlying evidence is relative to its freshness window.

reasons.description: Machine-readable reasons for anything that lowered confidence.
